description: Policy for the independent RedCap Arsenal public knowledge repository. RedCap keeps shared-knowledge/ as a safe template source; the durable local public-library worktree should live outside the RedCap repo. Public entries must come through RedCap Forge rather than raw reports or private archives.
user_namespace_rule: entries live under users/<safe_user_name>/ so team members can contribute to the same repository without mixing authorship; safe display case such as Norven is preserved
retrieval_rule: read catalog and metadata first; use rg/FTS for exact recall; only load entry bodies after the caller has a precise evidence need
forge_pipeline: RedCap Forge is the concrete distillation pipeline between private RedCap runtime artifacts and public redcap-arsenal entries: distill, privacy-scan, dedupe, structure, index, then append-only public entry creation or no-promote.
dedupe_rule: before append, compute a normalized fingerprint and reject exact duplicates; near-duplicate review remains a Prism or human-review concern until semantic retrieval exists
remote_boundary: The public RedCap Arsenal remote is bound in references/shared-knowledge-remote-binding.json. The remote may contain the minimal template surface plus RedCap Forge-reviewed append-only entries and generated metadata indexes; historical reports, raw lessons, identity, runtime evidence, host entry files, and private configuration remain out of scope.
